summary: Marginal boating day. Winds 5–10 kt, light chop on the bay. Scattered showers and storms build through the afternoon and evening and can spike local seas and gusts. Rain around 66%. Run the pass and any Gulf legs before early afternoon.
gulf_seas: Around 2 feet this morning, then 1 foot or less
source: NWS Tampa Bay, Coastal Waters Forecast (CWFTBW)
